content_html:
Last week Y Combinator posted an interview with Boris Cherny, the engineer who built Claude Code, about the new Opus 5 release (the full talk). It was running in the background, and I was only half-listening right up until he told the room:

...delete your CLAUDE.md, delete your skills, delete your hooks...

Whoa! What?! Let's rewind ... maybe I heard it wrong:

...for people that aren't building agentic products but you're using Claude code, every 6 months delete your CLAUDE.md, delete your skills, delete your hooks. See what the model does and it might surprise you. And actually for Opus 5, this is something we really do recommend is just try deleting all of these things because the model might really just not need all those instructions that you needed for past models. (6:57)

All righty then, time to re-watch the whole thing.

What was in the video

Earlier in the same conversation the host puts a number on what Anthropic did to its own house: "You actually deleted over 80% of the system prompt from Claude code" (3:31). Boris gives the reason in the same breath. Opus 5 is "just really intelligent," he says, and "a lot of the stuff in the system prompt was correcting for these behaviors that the model should have known," but "it didn't." Then: "Now, Opus 5 just does it" (4:18). Most of what got cut was scaffolding propping up a weaker model, and the propping stopped being load-bearing once the model could stand on its own.

So how did Anthropic make that cut? Internally it was an ablation: "you delete the entire system prompt and then you bring it back line by line to figure out what is the impact of each individual line" (6:03). One line at a time, each with a measured before and after. By the time it reaches the developer in the room it has compressed down to "just delete and see."

So why does the model that shipped this summer make the instruction file you tuned against 4.x behave so differently?

What Opus 5 changed about your instructions

I work on deterministic instruction evals, no LLM-as-a-judge, so I took a deeper look at what is happening and why, and at how to review your own instructions so you get the upgrade instead of a regression. Three mechanisms in this model generation change how a file you wrote a year ago lands, and they compound.

Instruction retrieval strength

It reaches for instructions over a wider range now, so even the vague and abstract rules that used to sit dormant fire on tasks they were never written for. And a vague rule names nothing concrete to bind to, so when it fires the model fills the gap with its own judgment instead of the outcome you intended.

LLM-as-a-judge, baked in

An LLM-as-a-judge pass is baked in, generally a bad idea in my view. It evaluates and re-checks its own output by default. Your old "verify / double-check" lines stack on that and it over-verifies, and over-verification pulls more instructions onto the turn, sharpening the same competition wider retrieval already set off.

Long-horizon tasks

Opus 5 runs long-horizon tasks now, what Boris calls auto mode. Connect that to the two mechanisms above and the same problem returns: the longer the trace, the more the model's own generated steps and assumptions crowd out your instructions, and the weakest go first.

Put the three together and a CLAUDE.md that behaved on 4.x can feel like it quit working on 5 without you touching a line of it. Remove the file and the noise goes at once, which is exactly why "just delete" feels like it works.

Boris is 73% right

Delete-the-bloat is sound advice, because most of your instruction file was never instruction. We pointed a deterministic analyzer at roughly 30,000 public repositories carrying agent instruction files and read every one the same way, no model in the loop, same file same result every time. The headline from that report: "Only 27% of your instruction file is doing what you think it does. The other 73% is scaffolding" (The State of AI Instruction Quality). Headings, restated context, examples, prose that arranges the file without ever telling the model to do anything. An independent ETH Zürich study of repository context files draws the same line: the instructions get followed, while the descriptive overviews, exactly the scaffolding we are talking about, do not improve results and add over 20% to inference cost (Evaluating AGENTS.md). Boris cut 80% of Claude Code's own system prompt, scaffolding his model had outgrown. Our data says roughly three-quarters of the average developer's CLAUDE.md is dead weight too, and it was dead well before Opus 5 shipped.

The 27% that is left is in worse shape than the ratio suggests. In the same corpus, 89.9% of agent configs carry at least one instruction that never names what it means (The Undiagnosed Input Problem), a rule like "keep the code clean" that reads fine to a person and binds nothing in the model. It is nearly everyone. Those figures are the Q2 2026 read; the Q3 report is in the making.

Delete is a blunt tool

Boris's method is ablation, the same move Anthropic used on its own prompt: delete the file, then add a line back only when a failure keeps recurring, never speculatively. When you are not time and token constrained, it is a sound method. What makes it the wrong answer for you is what it cannot see and what it costs to run.

What it cannot see

Start with what the add-back loop is buying: which rules were load-bearing. That is already a readable property of the file. An instruction that names the exact construct it is about gets followed with roughly a 10.9x odds ratio over the same rule stated as a category; when two rules contradict, the model lands hard on one and drops the other; and whether a rule loads where it applies is a fact about the text. Delete-and-observe ships a production failure to learn what a static read hands you for free.

It also learns only part of it. The loop restores a rule when a failure recurs and you can trace it, but two of the three defects never fail that cleanly. A low-specificity rule does not break, it underperforms silently, followed some of the time and not others. A conflict resolves silently too: Opus 5 follows the latest instruction in the set, and the losing rule reads as "ignored," which looks like flakiness rather than a diagnosable stumble. So the rebuild quietly puts the vague and conflicting rules back, because nothing in the delete-observe-add loop measured their quality. Deletion only ever touched the third defect, bloat.

There is also a category error sitting inside the delete list, because it runs past the CLAUDE.md to the skills and the hooks. A hook is a deterministic gate: it refuses an action outright rather than asking the model to weigh a sentence, and a deny-rule, a destructive-command block, or a compliance check does not get less necessary because the model got more capable. Enforcement never rode on the model's judgment in the first place, so a model upgrade does not retire it, and its absence does not surface as a gentle stumble the add-back loop catches. It surfaces as the destructive command that goes through. Cut the prose the model has outgrown, and keep the gate. I made the fuller case for that split in a separate piece: prompts steer, hooks enforce.

What it costs

Relearning which rules mattered by removing them and letting the model break is a fair trade when you are not time or token constrained, and for an Anthropic power user on a near-unlimited budget a rediscover-by-failure loop is background noise. For a developer on a normal budget it is not, and the cost is never one file. Picture running the ablation on every memory.md reference, every CLAUDE.md, every rule, skill, and agent, one by one, across every project you work on. Deleting a rule and waiting for the stumble means learning what your instructions were for by watching your own work break, one failure at a time, and you end up relearning the file you already had, minus whatever did not happen to break during the window. A static read tells you which rules bind without shipping a single failure to find out.

How to approach it

So read the file, do not shrink it. Opus 5 is more punishing when it meets faulty instructions, so the job is diagnostic: fix the rules that misfire, write the rest so a literal reader cannot misread them, and repeat.

Fix what you are seeing

Each of these is a failure you can watch for, with the remedy beside it:

  • Long answers, paragraphs for trivial steps. Instruct for brevity per surface: one line for chat replies, one for step-by-step narration, one for files it writes to disk, which run long on their own. effort changes thinking depth, not output length, so lowering it will not shorten any of them.
  • Scope creep, does more than you asked. State the scope in one line and let it make routine calls itself, checking in only when two readings would lead to materially different work. Scope is a judgment, so it steers rather than gates; the one enforceable slice is a write-path allowlist that refuses edits outside the files the task named.
  • Over-obeying a limiter. A hedge carried from a 4.x file now gets followed literally and under-reports. Anthropic flags it for Opus 5: a review prompt that hedges with only report high-severity issues or be conservative gets followed literally and reports less. Ask for everything and filter in a second pass.
  • Compulsive self-checking, corrections you did not ask for. Delete lines like double-check your answer or use a subagent to verify. Anthropic says the same: Opus 5 verifies its own work without being told to, and those instructions only cause over-verification. Do not read that as self-verification you can trust, though, its check is narration (see the last item).
  • Old 4.x instructions misfiring. Do not wipe them by vintage, you cannot see a rule's age, and blind deletion is the reflex this whole piece argues against. Target the classes Opus 5 inverted instead: verification prompts, be conservative hedges, do not think rules, effort defaults. Test each and keep what still binds.
  • Thrashes on conflicting rules. In a contradiction Opus 5 follows the latest rule and drops the other, and position decides which, so you cannot fix it by reordering. Find the contradiction and remove it; the pass that finds it checks same-subject rule pairs for "can both hold at once," not the file top to bottom.
  • A vague rule misfiring on unrelated tasks. Wider retrieval now fires a rule that used to sit dormant. Name its construct or scope it to a path so it stops loading on every turn.
  • Over-eager subagents. Cap it, this is a cost problem, not a quality one. Delegate only large, genuinely independent tracks, and never spin up a subagent to verify your own work.
  • Confident wrong assumptions, "done" when it is not. Steer it to state assumptions and flag gaps, then do not take its "done" on faith. Re-run the goal at the finish against a held-out check it never saw and cannot edit, and let it refuse and escalate when it cannot confirm.
  • Effort carried over from a 4.8 habit. Opus 5 defaults to high and adds an xhigh tier above it. If you had set effort explicitly for 4.8, Opus 5 leaves that setting unchanged rather than swapping in its own default, so a value you tuned for 4.8 is still live until you change it. Re-run an effort sweep: low and medium hold quality for most work, and xhigh earns its cost only on demanding agentic runs.

Write rules it can follow

The more interpretation you leave, the more Opus 5 fills the gap with its own judgment, which it does confidently and with the quality that got you here. So be specific, be imperative, and put one instruction per line. In a controlled experiment, naming the exact construct a rule is about is what separates Format with ruff format before committing from keep the code clean: the same rule to a human, wildly different compliance from the model.

When you write a constraint, order it. Lead with the directive and name the exact construct to use. Add one line of reasoning that reinforces it, and keep that line from re-naming the thing you are banning. Put any prohibition last and phrase it at the category level: under a crowded instruction file, naming the forbidden API anchors the model on it and the ban backfires, and on Opus 5 that bites harder. One imperative, one line of context, one restriction, in that order:

> - Lead every reply with the outcome: put the answer or the finding in the first sentence.
> - A reader who gets the result first can act on it right away and reads the rest as support.
> - Do not open with preamble, a recap of the request, or status narration.

The rules worth keeping share properties you can check without running the model even once:

  • They name a construct. Format with ruff format before committing, not keep the code clean.
  • They do not contradict each other. Two rules that disagree do not average out; the model follows one and drops the other, and you do not pick which.
  • They load where they apply. A rule about src/payments/ belongs in a file scoped to src/payments/, not on the always-on surface that taxes every unrelated turn.
  • They are behavior you want enforced, not documentation the model can read off the codebase.

Notice that "how many rules" is not on the list. A file of forty rules that all name constructs, none of which conflict, each scoped to where it applies, beats a file of eight vague ones every time. Count is downstream of quality.

Review it, don't let it grade itself

Anthropic makes the same case and ships a tool for it. Their context-engineering guidance for the Claude 5 generation says they found they were overconstraining Claude Code through the system prompt, the CLAUDE.md files, and the skills, and could delete many of those instructions and let the model use its judgment. They put the resulting best practices into a command: /doctor in Claude Code, to rightsize your skills and CLAUDE.md. Run it. It cuts what Claude can derive from the codebase, directory layouts, dependency lists, architecture overviews, keeps the pitfalls and the conventions that differ from tool defaults, and moves the rest into files that load on demand.

What /doctor rightsizes is bloat and placement. What it does not do is score the rules it keeps. Whether a rule names its construct, contradicts another, or loads where it applies is a property of the text with a definite answer you can compute by reading, and none of the three is what a bloat-trim measures. The trap is reaching for the model to close that gap. Asking Claude to grade its own rules runs straight into the LLM-as-a-judge and self-verify loop Opus 5 already applies to its own output, a stochastic guess on a question that has a deterministic answer. On a 200-line file that judge makes 200 of these calls, and its chance of getting the whole file right falls with every rule added, exactly where you reached for it.

So run /doctor first, then measure what it kept. Run a deterministic checker over your CLAUDE.md and rules, score them, and fix the vague and conflicting ones. I built one; any AST or deterministic instruction checker finds these defects.

Read the file, don't guess

Delete the bloat, genuinely. Then, before you add anything back on a feeling, measure what is left: whether each rule names what it means, whether it fights another rule, whether it loads where it belongs. Those three are readable off the file, and they are exactly what blind deletion cannot see. You keep what binds, cut the text that was never doing anything, and can say which is which instead of guessing.

I work on Reporails, deterministic diagnostics and governance for the instruction files, rules, and prompts that steer coding agents. It reads the steering surface you wrote down and tells you, with measured evidence, which instructions couple to behavior and which are text the model can ignore. It does not run your model, and it does not vote; it measures the file.

blocks.html_en: There is also a category error sitting inside the delete list, because it runs past the CLAUDE.md to the skills and the hooks. A hook is a deterministic gate: it refuses an action outright rather than asking the model to weigh a sentence, and a deny-rule, a destructive-command block, or a compliance check does not get less necessary because the model got more capable. Enforcement never rode on the model's judgment in the first place, so a model upgrade does not retire it, and its absence does not surface as a gentle stumble the add-back loop catches. It surfaces as the destructive command that goes through. Cut the prose the model has outgrown, and keep the gate. I made the fuller case for that split in a separate piece: prompts steer, hooks enforce.

blocks.html_en: What it costs

sentences.en: What it costs
sentences.zh: 费用是多少

blocks.html_en: Relearning which rules mattered by removing them and letting the model break is a fair trade when you are not time or token constrained, and for an Anthropic power user on a near-unlimited budget a rediscover-by-failure loop is background noise. For a developer on a normal budget it is not, and the cost is never one file. Picture running the ablation on every memory.md reference, every CLAUDE.md, every rule, skill, and agent, one by one, across every project you work on. Deleting a rule and waiting for the stumble means learning what your instructions were for by watching your own work break, one failure at a time, and you end up relearning the file you already had, minus whatever did not happen to break during the window. A static read tells you which rules bind without shipping a single failure to find out.

sentences.zh: 删除一条规则并等待失败意味着通过观察自己的工作中断（一次一个失败）来了解您的指令的用途，并且您最终会重新学习已有的文件，减去在窗口期间没有发生中断的任何内容。

sentences.en: A static read tells you which rules bind without shipping a single failure to find out.
sentences.zh: 静态读取会告诉您哪些规则绑定，而不会出现任何失败的情况。

blocks.html_en: How to approach it

sentences.en: How to approach it
sentences.zh: 如何接近它

blocks.html_en: So read the file, do not shrink it. Opus 5 is more punishing when it meets faulty instructions, so the job is diagnostic: fix the rules that misfire, write the rest so a literal reader cannot misread them, and repeat.

sentences.en: So read the file, do not shrink it.
sentences.zh: 所以读取文件，不要缩小它。

sentences.en: Opus 5 is more punishing when it meets faulty instructions, so the job is diagnostic: fix the rules that misfire, write the rest so a literal reader cannot misread them, and repeat.
sentences.zh: 当 Opus 5 遇到错误指令时，它会受到更大的惩罚，因此这项工作是诊断性的：修复失败的规则，写下其余的内容，这样文字读者就不会误读它们，然后重复。

blocks.html_en: Fix what you are seeing

sentences.en: Fix what you are seeing

blocks.html_en: Each of these is a failure you can watch for, with the remedy beside it:

sentences.en: Each of these is a failure you can watch for, with the remedy beside it:
sentences.zh: 每一个都是您可以留意的故障，并附上补救措施：

blocks.html_en: • Long answers, paragraphs for trivial steps. Instruct for brevity per surface: one line for chat replies, one for step-by-step narration, one for files it writes to disk, which run long on their own. effort changes thinking depth, not output length, so lowering it will not shorten any of them.

sentences.en: Long answers, paragraphs for trivial steps.
sentences.zh: 答案很长，步骤的段落也很长。

sentences.en: Instruct for brevity per surface: one line for chat replies, one for step-by-step narration, one for files it writes to disk, which run long on their own.
sentences.zh: 每个界面的简洁说明：一行用于聊天回复，一行用于逐步叙述，一行用于写入磁盘的文件，这些文件独立运行很长时间。

sentences.en: effort changes thinking depth, not output length, so lowering it will not shorten any of them.
sentences.zh: 努力改变思维深度，而不是输出长度，因此降低它不会缩短任何一个。

blocks.html_en: • Scope creep, does more than you asked. State the scope in one line and let it make routine calls itself, checking in only when two readings would lead to materially different work. Scope is a judgment, so it steers rather than gates; the one enforceable slice is a write-path allowlist that refuses edits outside the files the task named.

sentences.en: Scope creep, does more than you asked.
sentences.zh: 范围蔓延，比你要求的更多。

sentences.en: State the scope in one line and let it make routine calls itself, checking in only when two readings would lead to materially different work.
sentences.zh: 在一行中说明范围并让它自己进行例行调用，仅在两个读数会导致工作发生实质性不同时才进行检查。

sentences.en: Scope is a judgment, so it steers rather than gates; the one enforceable slice is a write-path allowlist that refuses edits outside the files the task named.
sentences.zh: 范围是一种判断，因此它是引导而不是大门；一个可执行的切片是一个写入路径允许列表，它拒绝在任务指定的文件之外进行编辑。

blocks.html_en: • Over-obeying a limiter. A hedge carried from a 4.x file now gets followed literally and under-reports. Anthropic flags it for Opus 5: a review prompt that hedges with only report high-severity issues or be conservative gets followed literally and reports less. Ask for everything and filter in a second pass.

sentences.en: Over-obeying a limiter.
sentences.zh: 过度服从限制者。

sentences.en: A hedge carried from a 4.x file now gets followed literally and under-reports.
sentences.zh: 从 4.x 文件中携带的对冲现在会按字面意思进行跟踪，并且报告不足。

sentences.en: Anthropic flags it for Opus 5: a review prompt that hedges with only report high-severity issues or be conservative gets followed literally and reports less.
sentences.zh: Anthropic 将其标记为 Opus 5：仅报告高严重性问题或保守的审查提示会按字面意思进行，报告较少。

sentences.en: Ask for everything and filter in a second pass.
sentences.zh: 询问所有内容并在第二次过滤中进行过滤。

blocks.html_en: • Compulsive self-checking, corrections you did not ask for. Delete lines like double-check your answer or use a subagent to verify. Anthropic says the same: Opus 5 verifies its own work without being told to, and those instructions only cause over-verification. Do not read that as self-verification you can trust, though, its check is narration (see the last item).

sentences.en: Compulsive self-checking, corrections you did not ask for.
sentences.zh: 强迫性的自我检查，你没有要求的纠正。

sentences.en: Delete lines like double-check your answer or use a subagent to verify.
sentences.zh: 删除诸如仔细检查答案或使用子代理进行验证之类的行。

sentences.en: Anthropic says the same: Opus 5 verifies its own work without being told to, and those instructions only cause over-verification.
sentences.zh: Anthropic 也这么说：Opus 5 在没有被告知的情况下验证了自己的工作，而这些指令只会导致过度验证。

sentences.en: Do not read that as self-verification you can trust, though, its check is narration (see the last item).
sentences.zh: 不要将其视为您可以信任的自我验证，但它的检查是旁白（请参阅最后一项）。

blocks.html_en: • Old 4.x instructions misfiring. Do not wipe them by vintage, you cannot see a rule's age, and blind deletion is the reflex this whole piece argues against. Target the classes Opus 5 inverted instead: verification prompts, be conservative hedges, do not think rules, effort defaults. Test each and keep what still binds.

sentences.en: Old 4.x instructions misfiring.
sentences.zh: 旧的 4.x 指令失败。

sentences.en: Do not wipe them by vintage, you cannot see a rule's age, and blind deletion is the reflex this whole piece argues against.
sentences.zh: 不要按年份来擦拭它们，你看不到规则的年龄，而盲目删除是整篇文章所反对的条件反射。

sentences.en: Target the classes Opus 5 inverted instead: verification prompts, be conservative hedges, do not think rules, effort defaults.
sentences.zh: 相反，Opus 5 的目标是倒转类：验证提示、保守对冲、不考虑规则、努力默认。

sentences.en: Test each and keep what still binds.
sentences.zh: 测试每一个并保留仍然绑定的内容。

blocks.html_en: • Thrashes on conflicting rules. In a contradiction Opus 5 follows the latest rule and drops the other, and position decides which, so you cannot fix it by reordering. Find the contradiction and remove it; the pass that finds it checks same-subject rule pairs for "can both hold at once," not the file top to bottom.

sentences.en: Thrashes on conflicting rules.
sentences.zh: 对相互冲突的规则进行猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: In a contradiction Opus 5 follows the latest rule and drops the other, and position decides which, so you cannot fix it by reordering.
sentences.zh: 在矛盾中，Opus 5 遵循最新的规则并丢弃另一个，并且位置决定哪个，所以你不能通过重新排序来修复它。

sentences.en: Find the contradiction and remove it; the pass that finds it checks same-subject rule pairs for "can both hold at once," not the file top to bottom.
sentences.zh: 找到矛盾并消除它；找到它的过程会检查相同主题的规则对是否“可以同时保留”，而不是从上到下检查文件。

blocks.html_en: • A vague rule misfiring on unrelated tasks. Wider retrieval now fires a rule that used to sit dormant. Name its construct or scope it to a path so it stops loading on every turn.

sentences.en: A vague rule misfiring on unrelated tasks.
sentences.zh: 模糊的规则在不相关的任务上失败了。

sentences.en: Wider retrieval now fires a rule that used to sit dormant.
sentences.zh: 现在，更广泛的检索激发了一条过去处于休眠状态的规则。

sentences.en: Name its construct or scope it to a path so it stops loading on every turn.
sentences.zh: 为其构造命名或将其范围限定为路径，以便它在每个回合都停止加载。

blocks.html_en: • Over-eager subagents. Cap it, this is a cost problem, not a quality one. Delegate only large, genuinely independent tracks, and never spin up a subagent to verify your own work.

sentences.en: Over-eager subagents.
sentences.zh: 过于热心的子代理。

sentences.en: Cap it, this is a cost problem, not a quality one.
sentences.zh: 顶一下，这是一个成本问题，而不是质量问题。

sentences.en: Delegate only large, genuinely independent tracks, and never spin up a subagent to verify your own work.
sentences.zh: 仅委托大型、真正独立的轨道，切勿启动子代理来验证您自己的工作。

blocks.html_en: • Confident wrong assumptions, "done" when it is not. Steer it to state assumptions and flag gaps, then do not take its "done" on faith. Re-run the goal at the finish against a held-out check it never saw and cannot edit, and let it refuse and escalate when it cannot confirm.

sentences.en: Confident wrong assumptions, "done" when it is not.
sentences.zh: 确信错误的假设，“完成”时却没有。

sentences.en: Steer it to state assumptions and flag gaps, then do not take its "done" on faith.
sentences.zh: 引导它陈述假设并标记差距，然后不要相信它的“完成”。

sentences.en: Re-run the goal at the finish against a held-out check it never saw and cannot edit, and let it refuse and escalate when it cannot confirm.
sentences.zh: 在结束时根据从未见过且无法编辑的保留检查重新运行目标，并在无法确认时让它拒绝并升级。

blocks.html_en: • Effort carried over from a 4.8 habit. Opus 5 defaults to high and adds an xhigh tier above it. If you had set effort explicitly for 4.8, Opus 5 leaves that setting unchanged rather than swapping in its own default, so a value you tuned for 4.8 is still live until you change it. Re-run an effort sweep: low and medium hold quality for most work, and xhigh earns its cost only on demanding agentic runs.

sentences.en: Effort carried over from a 4.8 habit.
sentences.zh: 4.8 习惯带来的努力。

sentences.en: Opus 5 defaults to high and adds an xhigh tier above it.
sentences.zh: Opus 5 默认为 high，并在其上方添加了 xhigh 层。

sentences.en: If you had set effort explicitly for 4.8, Opus 5 leaves that setting unchanged rather than swapping in its own default, so a value you tuned for 4.8 is still live until you change it.
sentences.zh: 如果您为 4.8 明确设置了工作量，Opus 5 会保留该设置不变，而不是交换到其自己的默认值，因此您为 4.8 调整的值仍然有效，直到您更改它。

sentences.en: Re-run an effort sweep: low and medium hold quality for most work, and xhigh earns its cost only on demanding agentic runs.
sentences.zh: 重新运行一次努力扫描：大多数工作的低和中等保持质量，xhigh 仅在要求较高的代理运行中才能获得成本。

blocks.html_en: Write rules it can follow

sentences.en: Write rules it can follow
sentences.zh: 写下它可以遵循的规则

blocks.html_en: The more interpretation you leave, the more Opus 5 fills the gap with its own judgment, which it does confidently and with the quality that got you here. So be specific, be imperative, and put one instruction per line. In a controlled experiment, naming the exact construct a rule is about is what separates Format with ruff format before committing from keep the code clean: the same rule to a human, wildly different compliance from the model.

sentences.en: The more interpretation you leave, the more Opus 5 fills the gap with its own judgment, which it does confidently and with the quality that got you here.
sentences.zh: 你留下的解释越多，Opus 5 就越能用自己的判断来填补空白，它自信地做到了这一点，并以让你走到这里的品质。

sentences.en: So be specific, be imperative, and put one instruction per line.
sentences.zh: 因此，要具体、命令式，每行放置一条指令。

sentences.en: In a controlled experiment, naming the exact construct a rule is about is what separates Format with ruff format before committing from keep the code clean: the same rule to a human, wildly different compliance from the model.
sentences.zh: 在受控实验中，命名规则所涉及的确切构造是将提交前的格式与 ruff 格式与保持代码清洁区分开来的：对人类来说相同的规则，与模型的合规性截然不同。

blocks.html_en: When you write a constraint, order it. Lead with the directive and name the exact construct to use. Add one line of reasoning that reinforces it, and keep that line from re-naming the thing you are banning. Put any prohibition last and phrase it at the category level: under a crowded instruction file, naming the forbidden API anchors the model on it and the ban backfires, and on Opus 5 that bites harder. One imperative, one line of context, one restriction, in that order:

sentences.en: When you write a constraint, order it.
sentences.zh: 当您编写约束时，请对其进行排序。

sentences.en: Lead with the directive and name the exact construct to use.
sentences.zh: 以指令开头并命名要使用的确切结构。

sentences.en: Add one line of reasoning that reinforces it, and keep that line from re-naming the thing you are banning.
sentences.zh: 添加一行推理来强化它，并防止该行重新命名您要禁止的事物。

sentences.en: Put any prohibition last and phrase it at the category level: under a crowded instruction file, naming the forbidden API anchors the model on it and the ban backfires, and on Opus 5 that bites harder.
sentences.zh: 将任何禁令放在最后并在类别级别上表述：在拥挤的指令文件下，命名被禁止的 API 会将模型锚定在其上，而禁令会适得其反，而在 Opus 5 上，情况会更严重。

sentences.en: One imperative, one line of context, one restriction, in that order:
sentences.zh: 一条命令、一行上下文、一项限制，按以下顺序：

blocks.html_en:

blocks.html_en: The rules worth keeping share properties you can check without running the model even once:

sentences.en: The rules worth keeping share properties you can check without running the model even once:
sentences.zh: 值得保留共享属性的规则您无需运行模型一次即可检查：

blocks.html_en: • They name a construct. Format with ruff format before committing, not keep the code clean.

sentences.en: They name a construct.
sentences.zh: 他们命名了一个结构。

sentences.en: Format with ruff format before committing, not keep the code clean.
sentences.zh: 提交前用ruff格式格式化，不保持代码干净。

blocks.html_en: • They do not contradict each other. Two rules that disagree do not average out; the model follows one and drops the other, and you do not pick which.

sentences.en: They do not contradict each other.
sentences.zh: 它们并不互相矛盾。

sentences.en: Two rules that disagree do not average out; the model follows one and drops the other, and you do not pick which.
sentences.zh: 两条不一致的规则不能平均；该模型跟随一个模型并丢弃另一个模型，并且您无需选择哪个模型。

blocks.html_en: • They load where they apply. A rule about src/payments/ belongs in a file scoped to src/payments/, not on the always-on surface that taxes every unrelated turn.

sentences.en: They load where they apply.
sentences.zh: 它们在应用的地方加载。

sentences.en: A rule about src/payments/ belongs in a file scoped to src/payments/, not on the always-on surface that taxes every unrelated turn.
sentences.zh: 关于 src/ payments/ 的规则属于 src/ payments/ 范围内的文件，而不是在对每个不相关的轮次征税的始终在线的表面上。

blocks.html_en: • They are behavior you want enforced, not documentation the model can read off the codebase.

sentences.en: They are behavior you want enforced, not documentation the model can read off the codebase.
sentences.zh: 它们是您想要强制执行的行为，而不是模型可以从代码库中读取的文档。

blocks.html_en: Notice that "how many rules" is not on the list. A file of forty rules that all name constructs, none of which conflict, each scoped to where it applies, beats a file of eight vague ones every time. Count is downstream of quality.

sentences.en: Notice that "how many rules" is not on the list.
sentences.zh: 请注意，“有多少规则”不在列表中。

sentences.en: A file of forty rules that all name constructs, none of which conflict, each scoped to where it applies, beats a file of eight vague ones every time.
sentences.zh: 一个由四十个规则组成的文件，所有名称都构建，没有一个冲突，每个规则都有其适用的范围，每次都会击败由八个模糊规则组成的文件。

sentences.en: Count is downstream of quality.
sentences.zh: 计数是质量的下游。

blocks.html_en: Review it, don't let it grade itself

sentences.en: Review it, don't let it grade itself
sentences.zh: 回顾它，不要让它自己评分

blocks.html_en: Anthropic makes the same case and ships a tool for it. Their context-engineering guidance for the Claude 5 generation says they found they were overconstraining Claude Code through the system prompt, the CLAUDE.md files, and the skills, and could delete many of those instructions and let the model use its judgment. They put the resulting best practices into a command: /doctor in Claude Code, to rightsize your skills and CLAUDE.md. Run it. It cuts what Claude can derive from the codebase, directory layouts, dependency lists, architecture overviews, keeps the pitfalls and the conventions that differ from tool defaults, and moves the rest into files that load on demand.

sentences.en: Anthropic makes the same case and ships a tool for it.
sentences.zh: Anthropic 制作了同样的案例并为其提供了一个工具。

sentences.en: Their context-engineering guidance for the Claude 5 generation says they found they were overconstraining Claude Code through the system prompt, the CLAUDE.md files, and the skills, and could delete many of those instructions and let the model use its judgment.
sentences.zh: 他们针对 Claude 5 代的上下文工程指南称，他们发现通过系统提示符、CLAUDE.md 文件和技能过度限制了 Claude Code，并且可以删除其中许多指令并让模型使用其判断。

sentences.en: They put the resulting best practices into a command: /doctor in Claude Code, to rightsize your skills and CLAUDE.md.
sentences.zh: 他们将由此产生的最佳实践放入命令中：Claude Code 中的 /doctor，以调整您的技能和 CLAUDE.md。

sentences.en: Run it.
sentences.zh: 运行它。

sentences.en: It cuts what Claude can derive from the codebase, directory layouts, dependency lists, architecture overviews, keeps the pitfalls and the conventions that differ from tool defaults, and moves the rest into files that load on demand.
sentences.zh: 它削减了克劳德可以从代码库、目录布局、依赖项列表、架构概述中获得的内容，保留与工具默认值不同的陷阱和约定，并将其余部分移动到按需加载的文件中。

blocks.html_en: What /doctor rightsizes is bloat and placement. What it does not do is score the rules it keeps. Whether a rule names its construct, contradicts another, or loads where it applies is a property of the text with a definite answer you can compute by reading, and none of the three is what a bloat-trim measures. The trap is reaching for the model to close that gap. Asking Claude to grade its own rules runs straight into the LLM-as-a-judge and self-verify loop Opus 5 already applies to its own output, a stochastic guess on a question that has a deterministic answer. On a 200-line file that judge makes 200 of these calls, and its chance of getting the whole file right falls with every rule added, exactly where you reached for it.

sentences.en: What /doctor rightsizes is bloat and placement.
sentences.zh: /doctor 调整的是膨胀和布局。

sentences.en: What it does not do is score the rules it keeps.
sentences.zh: 它不做的是对它所遵守的规则进行评分。

sentences.en: Whether a rule names its construct, contradicts another, or loads where it applies is a property of the text with a definite answer you can compute by reading, and none of the three is what a bloat-trim measures.
sentences.zh: 一条规则是否命名其构造、是否与另一个规则相矛盾或在其适用的位置加载是文本的一个属性，您可以通过阅读计算出明确的答案，而这三者中没有一个是膨胀修剪所测量的。

sentences.en: The trap is reaching for the model to close that gap.
sentences.zh: 陷阱正在让模型缩小这一差距。

sentences.en: Asking Claude to grade its own rules runs straight into the LLM-as-a-judge and self-verify loop Opus 5 already applies to its own output, a stochastic guess on a question that has a deterministic answer.
sentences.zh: 要求克劳德对自己的规则进行评分会直接进入法学硕士作为法官和自我验证循环，Opus 5 已经应用于自己的输出，即对具有确定性答案的问题的随机猜测。

sentences.en: On a 200-line file that judge makes 200 of these calls, and its chance of getting the whole file right falls with every rule added, exactly where you reached for it.
sentences.zh: 在一个 200 行的文件中，judge 会进行 200 次这样的调用，并且正确处理整个文件的机会会随着添加的每条规则而下降，而这正是您所达到的位置。

blocks.html_en: So run /doctor first, then measure what it kept. Run a deterministic checker over your CLAUDE.md and rules, score them, and fix the vague and conflicting ones. I built one; any AST or deterministic instruction checker finds these defects.

sentences.en: So run /doctor first, then measure what it kept.
sentences.zh: 因此，首先运行 /doctor，然后测量它保留的内容。

sentences.en: Run a deterministic checker over your CLAUDE.md and rules, score them, and fix the vague and conflicting ones.
sentences.zh: 对 CLAUDE.md 和规则运行确定性检查器，对它们进行评分，并修复模糊和冲突的规则。

sentences.en: I built one; any AST or deterministic instruction checker finds these defects.
sentences.zh: 我建造了一个；任何 AST 或确定性指令检查器都会发现这些缺陷。

blocks.html_en: Read the file, don't guess

sentences.en: Read the file, don't guess
sentences.zh: 阅读文件，不要猜测

blocks.html_en: Delete the bloat, genuinely. Then, before you add anything back on a feeling, measure what is left: whether each rule names what it means, whether it fights another rule, whether it loads where it belongs. Those three are readable off the file, and they are exactly what blind deletion cannot see. You keep what binds, cut the text that was never doing anything, and can say which is which instead of guessing.

sentences.en: Delete the bloat, genuinely.

content_html_zh:
上周，Y Combinator 发布了对构建 Claude Code 的工程师 Boris Cherny 的采访，内容涉及新的 Opus 5 版本（全文）。 它在后台运行，我只听了一半，直到他告诉房间里的人：

...删除你的CLAUDE.md，删除你的技能，删除你的钩子...

哇！ 什么？！ 让我们倒回... 也许我听错了：

...对于那些不构建代理产品但使用 Claude 代码的人，每 6 个月删除您的 CLAUDE.md，删除您的技能，删除您的钩子。 看看模型做了什么，它可能会让您感到惊讶。 实际上，对于 Opus 5，我们确实建议尝试删除所有这些内容，因为模型可能真的不需要过去模型所需的所有指令。 (6:57)

好吧，是时候重新观看整个事情了。

视频里讲了什么

在同一次对话的早些时候，主持人对 Anthropic 对自己房子所做的事情给出了数字：“您实际上从 Claude 代码中删除了超过 80% 的系统提示”(3:31)。 鲍里斯同时给出了原因。 Opus 5“真的非常智能”，他说，“系统提示中的很多内容都在纠正模型应该知道的这些行为”，但“它没有”。 然后：“现在，Opus 5 就做到了”（4:18）。 大部分被砍掉的是支撑较弱模型的脚手架，一旦模型能够独立站立，支撑就不再承重。

那么 Anthropic 是如何做到这一点的呢？ 在内部，这是一种消融：“您删除整个系统提示符，然后逐行将其恢复，以弄清楚每行的影响是什么”(6:03)。 一次一行，每行前后都有测量值。 当它到达房间里的开发人员时，它已经压缩为“只需删除并查看”。

那么为什么今年夏天发布的模型会让您针对 4.x 调整的指令文件表现如此不同呢？

Opus 5 对您的说明进行了哪些更改

我从事确定性指令评估，而不是法学硕士作为法官，所以我更深入地了解了正在发生的事情和原因，以及如何审查自己的指令，以便获得升级而不是回归。 此模型生成中的三种机制改变了您一年前编写的文件的落地方式，并且它们组合在一起。

指令检索强度

现在，它涵盖了更广泛的范围，因此，即使是那些过去在它们从未编写过的任务中处于休眠状态的模糊和抽象规则。 模糊的规则没有指定任何具体的约束，因此当它触发时，模型会用自己的判断而不是您想要的结果来填补空白。

法学硕士法官，烘焙

在我看来，获得法学硕士法官资格是一个坏主意。 默认情况下，它会评估并重新检查自己的输出。 你的旧的“验证/双重检查”线叠加在上面，它过度验证，过度验证将更多的指令拉到转牌上，从而加剧了已经开始的更广泛的检索的相同竞争。

长期任务

Opus 5 现在运行长期任务，鲍里斯称之为自动模式。 将其与上面的两种机制联系起来，就会出现同样的问题：跟踪越长，模型自己生成的步骤和假设就越会挤占您的指令，并且最弱的先行。

将这三者放在一起，在 4.x 上运行的 CLAUDE.md 感觉就像在 5 上停止工作一样，而无需触及其中的任何一行。 删除文件，噪音就会立即消失，这正是“直接删除”感觉有效的原因。

鲍里斯说对了 73%

删除膨胀是合理的建议，因为你的大部分指令文件从来都不是指令。 我们将确定性分析器指向大约 30,000 个携带代理指令文件的公共存储库，并以相同的方式读取每个存储库，循环中没有模型，每次相同的文件都会产生相同的结果。 该报告的标题是：“你的指令文件中只有 27% 做了你认为它会做的事情。 另外 73% 是脚手架”（人工智能指令质量状况）。 标题、重述上下文、示例、散文排列文件，而无需告诉模型执行任何操作。 苏黎世联邦理工学院对存储库上下文文件的一项独立研究得出了同样的结论：遵循指令，而描述性概述（正是我们正在讨论的脚手架）不会改善结果，并且会增加超过 20% 的推理成本（Evaluating AGENTS.md）。 Boris 削减了 Claude Code 自己的系统提示符的 80%，他的模型的脚手架已经无法满足需要。 我们的数据显示，平均开发人员的 CLAUDE.md 中大约有四分之三也是无用的，而且早在 Opus 5 发布之前就已经无用了。

剩下的 27% 的情况比该比例显示的更糟糕。 在同一个语料库中，89.9% 的代理配置至少携带一条从未命名其含义的指令（未诊断的输入问题），即“保持代码干净”之类的规则，它对人来说很好读，并且在模型中不绑定任何内容。 几乎每个人都是如此。 这些数字是 2026 年第二季度的数据；第三季度报告正在制作中。

删除是一个生硬的工具

鲍里斯的方法是消融，与 Anthropic 在自己的提示中使用的方法相同：删除文件，然后仅在故障不断重复出现时添加一行，而不是推测。 当您不受时间和令牌限制时，这是一种合理的方法。 它对您来说是错误的答案，因为它看不到什么以及运行成本如何。

它看不到什么

从回加循环购买什么开始：哪些规则是承载的。 这已经是文件的可读属性。 一条命名了它所涉及的确切结构的指令，其优势比大约为类别所规定的相同规则的 10.9 倍；当两条规则相矛盾时，模型会严格遵循其中一条规则，而放弃另一条规则；规则是否加载到它适用的地方是关于文本的事实。 删除并观察会带来生产故障，以免费了解静态读取为您提供的内容。

它也只学习其中的一部分。 当故障再次发生时，循环会恢复规则，并且您可以跟踪它，但是三个缺陷中的两个永远不会彻底失败。 低特异性规则不会被打破，它会默默地表现不佳，在某些时候遵循，而在其他时候则不遵循。 冲突也会悄然解决：Opus 5 遵循集合中的最新指令，而失败的规则读作“被忽略”，这看起来像是不稳定，而不是可诊断的失误。 因此，重建会悄悄地将模糊且相互冲突的规则放回原处，因为删除-观察-添加循环中没有任何内容可以衡量它们的质量。 删除只触及第三个缺陷，膨胀。

删除列表中还存在一个类别错误，因为它经过 CLAUDE.md 到达技能和挂钩。 钩子是一个确定性的门：它直接拒绝一个动作，而不是要求模型权衡一个句子，并且拒绝规则、破坏性命令块或合规性检查并不会因为模型变得更强大而变得不那么必要。 执行从一开始就不会依赖于模型的判断，因此模型升级不会使模型的判断失效，并且模型的缺失也不会表现为回加循环捕获的轻微故障。 它表现为所经历的破坏性命令。 剪掉模型已经不再适用的散文，保留大门。 我在另一篇文章中对这种分割做了更全面的说明：提示转向，钩子强制。

费用是多少

当你没有时间或代币限制时，通过删除规则并让模型崩溃来重新学习哪些规则是重要的，这是一个公平的交易，而对于预算近乎无限的人性超级用户来说，失败重新发现循环是背景噪音。 对于预算正常的开发人员来说，情况并非如此，而且成本从来都不是一个文件。 想象一下，在您从事的每个项目中，对每个 memory.md 参考、每个 CLAUDE.md、每个规则、技能和代理进行消融，一一进行。 删除一条规则并等待失败意味着通过观察自己的工作中断（一次一个失败）来了解您的指令的用途，并且您最终会重新学习已有的文件，减去在窗口期间没有发生中断的任何内容。 静态读取会告诉您哪些规则绑定，而不会出现任何失败的情况。

如何接近它

所以读取文件，不要缩小它。 当 Opus 5 遇到错误指令时，它会受到更大的惩罚，因此这项工作是诊断性的：修复失败的规则，写下其余的内容，这样文字读者就不会误读它们，然后重复。

修复您所看到的内容

每一个都是您可以留意的故障，并附上补救措施：

  • 答案很长，步骤的段落也很长。 每个界面的简洁说明：一行用于聊天回复，一行用于逐步叙述，一行用于写入磁盘的文件，这些文件独立运行很长时间。 努力改变思维深度，而不是输出长度，因此降低它不会缩短任何一个。
  • 范围蔓延，比你要求的更多。 在一行中说明范围并让它自己进行例行调用，仅在两个读数会导致工作发生实质性不同时才进行检查。 范围是一种判断，因此它是引导而不是大门；一个可执行的切片是一个写入路径允许列表，它拒绝在任务指定的文件之外进行编辑。
  • 过度服从限制者。 从 4.x 文件中携带的对冲现在会按字面意思进行跟踪，并且报告不足。 Anthropic 将其标记为 Opus 5：仅报告高严重性问题或保守的审查提示会按字面意思进行，报告较少。 询问所有内容并在第二次过滤中进行过滤。
  • 强迫性的自我检查，你没有要求的纠正。 删除诸如仔细检查答案或使用子代理进行验证之类的行。 Anthropic 也这么说：Opus 5 在没有被告知的情况下验证了自己的工作，而这些指令只会导致过度验证。 不要将其视为您可以信任的自我验证，但它的检查是旁白（请参阅最后一项）。
  • 旧的 4.x 指令失败。 不要按年份来擦拭它们，你看不到规则的年龄，而盲目删除是整篇文章所反对的条件反射。 相反，Opus 5 的目标是倒转类：验证提示、保守对冲、不考虑规则、努力默认。 测试每一个并保留仍然绑定的内容。
  • 对相互冲突的规则进行猛烈抨击。 在矛盾中，Opus 5 遵循最新的规则并丢弃另一个，并且位置决定哪个，所以你不能通过重新排序来修复它。 找到矛盾并消除它；找到它的过程会检查相同主题的规则对是否“可以同时保留”，而不是从上到下检查文件。
  • 模糊的规则在不相关的任务上失败了。 现在，更广泛的检索激发了一条过去处于休眠状态的规则。 为其构造命名或将其范围限定为路径，以便它在每个回合都停止加载。
  • 过于热心的子代理。 顶一下，这是一个成本问题，而不是质量问题。 仅委托大型、真正独立的轨道，切勿启动子代理来验证您自己的工作。
  • 确信错误的假设，“完成”时却没有。 引导它陈述假设并标记差距，然后不要相信它的“完成”。 在结束时根据从未见过且无法编辑的保留检查重新运行目标，并在无法确认时让它拒绝并升级。
  • 4.8 习惯带来的努力。 Opus 5 默认为 high，并在其上方添加了 xhigh 层。 如果您为 4.8 明确设置了工作量，Opus 5 会保留该设置不变，而不是交换到其自己的默认值，因此您为 4.8 调整的值仍然有效，直到您更改它。 重新运行一次努力扫描：大多数工作的低和中等保持质量，xhigh 仅在要求较高的代理运行中才能获得成本。

写下它可以遵循的规则

你留下的解释越多，Opus 5 就越能用自己的判断来填补空白，它自信地做到了这一点，并以让你走到这里的品质。 因此，要具体、命令式，每行放置一条指令。 在受控实验中，命名规则所涉及的确切构造是将提交前的格式与 ruff 格式与保持代码清洁区分开来的：对人类来说相同的规则，与模型的合规性截然不同。

当您编写约束时，请对其进行排序。 以指令开头并命名要使用的确切结构。 添加一行推理来强化它，并防止该行重新命名您要禁止的事物。 将任何禁令放在最后并在类别级别上表述：在拥挤的指令文件下，命名被禁止的 API 会将模型锚定在其上，而禁令会适得其反，而在 Opus 5 上，情况会更严重。 一条命令、一行上下文、一项限制，按以下顺序：

> - 以结果引导每个回复：将答案或发现放在第一句话中。 > - 首先得到结果的读者可以立即采取行动，并阅读其余内容作为支持。 > - 不要以序言、请求回顾或状态叙述作为开头。

值得保留共享属性的规则您无需运行模型一次即可检查：

  • 他们命名了一个结构。 提交前用ruff格式格式化，不保持代码干净。
  • 它们并不互相矛盾。 两条不一致的规则不能平均；该模型跟随一个模型并丢弃另一个模型，并且您无需选择哪个模型。
  • 它们在应用的地方加载。 关于 src/ payments/ 的规则属于 src/ payments/ 范围内的文件，而不是在对每个不相关的轮次征税的始终在线的表面上。
  • 它们是您想要强制执行的行为，而不是模型可以从代码库中读取的文档。

请注意，“有多少规则”不在列表中。 一个由四十个规则组成的文件，所有名称都构建，没有一个冲突，每个规则都有其适用的范围，每次都会击败由八个模糊规则组成的文件。 计数是质量的下游。

回顾它，不要让它自己评分

Anthropic 制作了同样的案例并为其提供了一个工具。 他们针对 Claude 5 代的上下文工程指南称，他们发现通过系统提示符、CLAUDE.md 文件和技能过度限制了 Claude Code，并且可以删除其中许多指令并让模型使用其判断。 他们将由此产生的最佳实践放入命令中：Claude Code 中的 /doctor，以调整您的技能和 CLAUDE.md。 运行它。 它削减了克劳德可以从代码库、目录布局、依赖项列表、架构概述中获得的内容，保留与工具默认值不同的陷阱和约定，并将其余部分移动到按需加载的文件中。

/doctor 调整的是膨胀和布局。 它不做的是对它所遵守的规则进行评分。 一条规则是否命名其构造、是否与另一个规则相矛盾或在其适用的位置加载是文本的一个属性，您可以通过阅读计算出明确的答案，而这三者中没有一个是膨胀修剪所测量的。 陷阱正在让模型缩小这一差距。 要求克劳德对自己的规则进行评分会直接进入法学硕士作为法官和自我验证循环，Opus 5 已经应用于自己的输出，即对具有确定性答案的问题的随机猜测。 在一个 200 行的文件中，judge 会进行 200 次这样的调用，并且正确处理整个文件的机会会随着添加的每条规则而下降，而这正是您所达到的位置。

因此，首先运行 /doctor，然后测量它保留的内容。 对 CLAUDE.md 和规则运行确定性检查器，对它们进行评分，并修复模糊和冲突的规则。 我建造了一个；任何 AST 或确定性指令检查器都会发现这些缺陷。

阅读文件，不要猜测

真正删除臃肿的内容。 然后，在你对某种感觉添加任何内容之前，衡量一下剩下的内容：每个规则是否命名了它的含义，它是否与另一个规则相冲突，它是否加载了它所属的位置。 这三个是从文件中可读的，而它们正是盲删除所看不到的。 您保留绑定的内容，删除从未执行任何操作的文本，并且可以说出哪个是哪个而不是猜测。

我致力于 Reporails、指导编码代理的指令文件、规则和提示的确定性诊断和治理。 它会读取您写下的转向表面，并通过测量的证据告诉您哪些指令与行为耦合以及哪些是模型可以忽略的文本。 它不运行你的模型，也不投票；它测量文件。
